closets.title: The Whole Damn Wardrobe
closets.tagline: my closet, temporarily available to the public.
closets.intro: I’m moving and my baggage allowance has opinions. Everything here needs a new home by the end of the month — some of it’s a gift, some of it’s for sale, all of it was loved. Call dibs before your group chat does.

items.story: Car-boot sale, three euros and a compliment. Two weddings and one funeral, impeccable at all three.
items.name: The Crochet Cape
items.hook: Your nan made this. Not your nan specifically. Someone’s nan.
items.description: Hand-crocheted, tasselled, and completely without practical purpose — which is the point. Throw it over anything and become 40% more interesting. Tiny snag on the back left that I’ve decided is a feature.

photos.alt: Cream hand-crocheted tasselled cape on a wooden hanger

queue.name: Priya
queue.note: been eyeing this for two years. it is my time.

items.story: Lived on the back of my desk chair so long it left a mark. We’re both fine now.
items.name: Sherpa-Collar Denim Trucker
items.hook: The jacket equivalent of a golden retriever.
items.description: Broken in to that not-too-stiff, not-too-slouchy place it takes denim three winters to reach. Sherpa collar for when the pub garden gets ambitious. Goes over everything, forgives everything.

photos.alt: Light-wash denim trucker jacket with a cream sherpa collar

items.name: Pastel Sneakers
items.hook: Worn three times. All to brunch.
items.description: Chunky double-vision silhouette in the softest sherbet pastels — lilac, butter, baby blue. They make everything you own look more expensive and slightly French. Soles still cream, not grey.

photos.alt: Pastel lilac, yellow and blue chunky trainers on a pink background

items.story: Bonus-cheque energy. Beautiful, used four times, because I’m scared of it. Someone braver should have it.
items.name: Coral Top-Handle Bag
items.size: Small — fits phone, cardholder, one snack
items.hook: An investment I am now divesting.
items.description: Structured box shape in a coral that is somehow both loud and tasteful. Silver push-lock, detachable strap, feet on the base so it doesn’t scuff. Full dust bag. Corners perfect — I checked with a torch.

photos.alt: Structured coral-red leather top-handle handbag with a silver lock

items.name: Light-Wash Boyfriend Jeans
items.hook: Already broken in on your behalf. You’re welcome.
items.description: That impossible-to-fake soft light wash that only comes from actual sunlight and actual years. Slight whiskering at the hip, one nearly-there hole at the left knee that I forbid you to patch.

photos.alt: Faded light-wash blue jeans on a wooden hanger in warm light

items.story: This coat has genuinely changed how strangers speak to me. Please be nice to it.
items.name: The Camel Wrap Coat
items.hook: Does 80% of the outfit’s work and asks for nothing.
items.description: Wool-blend, self-tie belt, no buttons to lose, a collar you can pop against weather or people. Throw it over gym kit and you look like you have a lunch reservation. Relined at the cuffs by a very good tailor.

photos.alt: Camel wool wrap coat with a self-tie belt, worn on stone steps

queue.name: Nadia
queue.note: collected! wearing them right now actually

items.story: Found in a jar of buttons at a house clearance. Best fifty cents ever spent.
items.name: Round Gold Sunglasses
items.hook: Makes you look like you have opinions about natural wine.
items.description: Tiny round gold frames, proper dark bottle-green glass, that satisfying click when they fold. One nose pad replaced — you genuinely cannot tell unless I point at it, which I just did.

photos.alt: Round gold-framed sunglasses with dark green lenses on marble

looks.title: Good Vibes, Bad Decisions
looks.caption: striped wide-legs, a white crop, the bag that started three arguments. peak 1am energy.

photo.alt: Person under a neon sign in striped wide-leg trousers and a white crop top

looks.title: Retail Therapy, Terminal Stage
looks.caption: big coat, leather gloves, more bags than hands. do not let this person near a card machine.

photo.alt: Person in a long coat and sunglasses holding several shopping bags

offers.name: Marguerite
offers.message: I know it’s under asking — but it’d be so loved, and I can collect this week.
